decisions.reason: Locates the half-cell fg-only branches, explains the transitive 48;2 background bleed into the empty half, gives the fg+ESC[49m fix (or reset-before-change) with simulated verification, notes left-edge immunity and row-end reset timing, and blames neither data nor emulator.

Explains the trim and whitespace-stripping pipeline so surplus columns are never overwritten, and proposes ESC[0m ESC[K row termination plus fixed-width canvas/union-region coverage, keeping SGR controlled and not relying on padded spaces.

Reports tail2 hand-port mismatch with 23 differing cells, distinguishes data drift from the two render bugs, explains the different-frame excerpt regression missed it, and requires an all-frame source-art digest gate that fails closed with converter-only golden provenance.

Explains the self-rearming ref'd timer chain pinning the loop, mount-without-unmount CI hosts, TTY/stdin keeping the interactive product alive, and the unref-per-reschedule fix that preserves animation; rejects timeout-extension/global-stop alternatives.

Checklist consolidates absolute SGR, EL row termination, whitespace independence, all-frame digest gates and timer lifecycle; rollout audit inventories mounting hosts (especially headless probes that never unmount) and proposes natural-exit/live-handle liveness regressions.

caps.reason: Final advice requires background reset, erase-to-EOL coverage, source-backed digests and unref; trimming is retained only with EL coverage and the emulator is explicitly not blamed.
